result.topic_en: The page combines a draft lecture announcement (theory of elasticity, Latin and German) with pencil work on a second-order differential equation in log λ, solved by a power series with a recurrence for the coefficients a_μ.

methods.what: Second-order linear differential equation in the variable log λ
Cubic polynomial factor appearing as the leading coefficient
Power-series substitution u = Σ a_μ λ^μ, giving coefficient terms for a three-term recurrence
